speaker: Doctor
text:
The lab results show isolated unconjugated hyperbilirubinemia with normal liver enzymes, which effectively rules out biliary atresia and metabolic disorders like galactosemia. Since the infant is thriving, exclusively breastfed, and has no other symptoms, this presentation is classic for breast milk jaundice.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Breast milk jaundice
